scope: Fixed Unicode 18 / UAX14 revision 57 default optional and mandatory break opportunities, raw property queries and explicit SA positions. Full official corpus and independent dense data verification. Not dictionary segmentation, target-application tailoring, width fitting, discretionary hyphen rendering, line-boundary shaping, geometry or painting.
artifactSizeScope: Incomplete development CLI/worker and Rust/C++ WASM artifacts only. Full rendering/media/fonts/host distribution and installer sizes are not measured here. Link-layout size changes in otherwise unchanged components are not performance claims.
limitations: The fixed default profile implements UAX14 opportunities only. Official test completeness means every published case was executed with no skips, not exhaustive proof for every possible string or Office/WPS conformance.

LB1 uses the standard default resolution, including SA to AL/CM. Original SA scalar positions are returned explicitly; dictionary-based segmentation for Thai and other complex-context languages remains required for the complete product.

Default UAX14 may permit a break inside an extended grapheme after SPACE. The later typography profile must explicitly coordinate graphemes, shaping clusters, non-break fields and allowed tailoring; this API does not authorize cutting glyph arrays.
Width selection, language-specific hyphenation, discretionary hyphen glyphs and spelling changes, Office/CJK tailoring, tabs, justification, overflow and emergency breaking remain incomplete.
Soft wrapping must leave author text untouched, then trigger required contextual reshaping and actual per-line bidi L1/L2. This default analysis does not perform those later steps.
EastAsian means membership in the EAW F/W/H set, not a measured font advance. Auxiliary properties are explicitly limited subsets of General_Category, not a general category API.
Empty input follows start-of-text prohibition: zero end coordinates and no opportunities. The layout layer must still produce an empty paragraph line when required by document semantics.
Core cancellation checkpoints and bounded inputs are tested; production host hard-cancel latency, complete peak-memory accounting and browser Worker deployment remain unverified.
No new end-to-end performance claim is made. Runtime table and current development artifact sizes do not estimate full kernel distribution or Musterwork desktop installer size.
Full rendering, playback, editable advanced presentation semantics, Office/WPS acceptance and Musterwork replacement gates E0-E3 remain incomplete.
